name: Phone Connect
author: Brett
description: Connects Brett's Android phone to the console through the small Phone Connect companion app (phone-connect@1). Pair the phone with a code or QR, see it online, revoke it. The phone shows a floating toolbar and popups for approvals, alerts and notifications that act in place, watches axHub with the screen off (Monitor, with auto-approval rules kept here), opens amberxai.com pages on command, and records what the phone plays (Audio Output Recorder: 30-minute parts to axHub, transcribed on the VPS, mic only when switched on). Replaces AmberX.

items.title: Phone status
items.description: The paired phone: online or when last seen, and the pairing code waiting, if any.

items.title: Phones
items.description: Every phone paired, revoked or migrated, with online state and last seen.

items.title: One phone
items.description: One phone's record: name, app version, capabilities, online state, last seen.

items.title: Pair a phone
items.description: Issues an 8-character pairing code (10 minutes, single use) and a QR link. The phone claims it while signed in with Brett's own hub session; nothing else pairs it.

items.title: Pairing code waiting
items.description: The pairing code waiting for the phone, or none.

items.title: Cancel pairing
items.description: Drops the waiting pairing code.

items.title: Revoke a phone
items.description: The phone is refused from now on; every command to it answers revoked. Body {why?}.

items.title: Forget a revoked phone
items.description: Drops a revoked phone's record.

items.title: Open a page on the phone
items.description: Opens an https page on amberxai.com (or a subdomain) on the phone in Chrome or the default browser. Body {url, browser?: chrome|default}. Queued while the phone is offline; acked when it opened.

items.title: Notify the phone
items.description: Sends a phone notification. Body {kind: fyi|fix-update|alert|approval, title, body?, url?}. Skipped when that type is switched off.

items.title: Commands sent
items.description: The command queue: what was sent to the phone, delivered, acked or failed.

items.title: One command
items.description: One command's status and the phone's result.

items.title: Phone settings
items.description: browser, notify switches per type, monitor, recorderMic.

items.title: Change phone settings
items.description: Body: any of {browser, notify: {fyi, fix-update, alert, approval}, monitor, recorderMic}. recorderMic only turns on from Brett's own click.

items.title: Start the recorder
items.description: Starts the phone's Audio Output Recorder. A straight approval on axHub (no countdown, never automatic); Android asks for capture consent. Body {session_name, group?, note?}.

items.title: Stop the recorder
items.description: Stops the phone's Audio Output Recorder; the part so far is uploaded.

items.title: Recorder status
items.description: Running or not, session, current part, uploaded parts, upload queue, mic switch, transcripts.

items.title: Transcripts
items.description: The transcription worker: on, engine, waiting, last, failed.

items.title: Transcribe now
items.description: Looks for recorder parts to transcribe now instead of at the next round.

items.title: Auto-approval rules
items.description: Every auto-approval rule for the Monitor watch, active or proposed.

items.title: Add an auto-approval rule
items.description: Body {what: tool or family.*, scope?: any|project:<id>|agent:<id>|build:<id>, expiresAt?, note?}. From a command it is proposed until Brett turns it on. Never covers destructive tools, personOnly actions, recorder_start or vps.run.

items.title: Turn a rule on or off
items.description: Body {on}. Turning on is Brett's own click only; off works from anywhere.

items.title: Remove a rule
items.description: Removes an auto-approval rule.

items.title: Would a rule approve this?
items.description: Body {tool, project?, agent?, build?, destructive?, personOnly?} → {approve, rule?, why}.
